intro: Good days out deserve easy pit stops. Find a public toilet nearby, without the awkward café order.
locationDenied: Location unavailable. Search a town or choose a spot on the map.
emptyHint: Try a wider radius or choose another spot.
startHint: Search a town, use your location, or choose a spot on the map. We’ll take it from there.
mapHint: Tap the map to choose a search location
sourceHours: Hours are from map data; current opening is not verified.
stale: This dataset is over two weeks old. Details may have changed.
truncated: Showing the nearest results. Narrow your search to see more.
tileError: The map is taking a comfort break. The toilet list still works.
footerText: For life’s little emergencies. Made for everyone out and about in Germany.
how1Text: Use your location, search a town or postcode, or pick a point on the map.
how2Text: Filter free or paid toilets. Missing information stays unknown.
how3Text: Check the details and open walking directions in Google Maps.
privacyText: Searches run on this site’s server. We do not store location history. Your language choice is saved only in this browser. OpenStreetMap receives your IP address and the map tiles you view. Google Maps opens only when you choose walking directions. Names and opening hours come from community map data and may be incomplete. Map labels follow the tile provider’s language.
dataLicense: Toilet and settlement data: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Map tiles: OpenStreetMap. Icons: Lucide (ISC).
refreshFailed: The last data refresh failed. The previous dataset is still in use.
noMatches: No towns or postcodes found. Try another name or choose the map.
mapUnavailable: Map configuration is unavailable. You can still search towns and browse the list.
INVALID_QUERY: Check the search location and radius, then try again.
OUTSIDE_COVERAGE: We cover Germany for now. Choose a location in Germany.
DATA_NOT_READY: The toilet dataset is not ready yet. The site operator needs to run the first import.
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The search service is unavailable. Please try again shortly.
NOT_FOUND: This item could not be found.
statusError: Could not check the data status. Try again.
comfort: Take a breath. Take a break.
mapLabels: Map labels follow the source language.
openNowHint: Open according to recorded hours. Missing or uncertain hours are excluded.
